content: Task: time-series forecasting - predict future values of a quantity from its own history and related signals | requires: a regularly sampled history, a forecast horizon, and known future drivers such as calendars | produces: a forecast per future step with an uncertainty range | families: ML (exponential-smoothing and autoregressive models; gradient-boosted trees over lagged features; recurrent or attention-based sequence models) | metrics: MAE, RMSE and MAPE over the horizon
source_reference: Shared-layer source note (Module 1 team, 2026-09-12), Task patterns: time-series forecasting
